name: @aturi/packages
description: Nested workspace root for the publishable Aturi waypoint packages. Links @aturi/waypoints and @aturi/waypoints-react locally during development; not published itself.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @aturi/waypoints && npm run build -w @aturi/waypoints-react
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @aturi/waypoints && npm run typecheck -w @aturi/waypoints-react
